verses.t: “Kiṁsu bandhati pātheyyaṁ, kiṁsu bhogānamāsayo; Kiṁsu naraṁ parikassati, kiṁsu lokasmi dujjahaṁ; Kismiṁ baddhā puthū sattā, pāsena sakuṇī yathā”ti.
“Saddhā bandhati pātheyyaṁ, sirī bhogānamāsayo; Icchā naraṁ parikassati, icchā lokasmi dujjahā; Icchābaddhā puthū sattā, pāsena sakuṇī yathā”ti.
